data.title: Anupam Rasayan Board Clears INR 160 Crore NCD Issue for Debt Refinancing
data.description:
Anupam Rasayan India Ltd. ( (IN:ANURAS) ) has shared an announcement.

Anupam Rasayan India Ltd.’s board has approved the private placement of up to 16,000 secured, rated, unlisted, redeemable non-convertible debentures, with a total size not exceeding INR 160 crore. The debentures will be issued in dematerialised form at par to Aditya Birla Capital Ltd., with CTL Trusteeship Ltd. acting as debenture trustee and multiple security arrangements including share pledges and hypothecation over an escrow account.

The company plans to use the proceeds to repay existing debt facilities, invest in group companies and support general corporate purposes, indicating a focus on balance sheet strengthening and strategic funding flexibility. Execution details of the debenture-related security documents will be shared with the exchanges upon completion, underlining continued compliance with SEBI listing disclosure norms and transparency for investors.

data.title: RVNL Wins Rs 404.9 Crore East Coast Railway Contract for Third Line Project
data.description:
Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd. ( (IN:RVNL) ) just unveiled an update.

Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd., a state-run rail infrastructure developer, executes turnkey projects including track laying, bridges, buildings and electrification works for Indian Railways. Operating mainly as a project execution and capacity-creation specialist, it focuses on enhancing rail corridors and supporting long-term network modernization across the country.

The company has received a Letter of Acceptance from East Coast Railway for a domestic contract worth about Rs 404.9 crore, covering roadbed, bridges, buildings, ballast supply, track linking and extensive utility and electrification works between Khurda Road and Gangadharpur. The 912-day project, linked to construction of a third line on the Bhadrak–Vizianagaram section, falls in the normal course of business and strengthens RVNL’s order book while reinforcing its role in expanding critical rail capacity on this busy corridor.
